summary: Tested to_flag normalisation of on/heating/mode and the chamber OFF hint. Backend: a temporary non-simulated 3-chamber Kowalski device got real MQTT messages via broker.hivemq.com with ch0 on:0/heating:0/mode:"0", ch1 on:"1"/heating:1/mode:"1", ch2 on:true/heating:"0"/mode:"auto". GET /api/devices returned ch0 on=false, heating=false, auto; ch1 on=true, heating=true, manual; ch2 on=true, heating=false, auto. set_mode returned 200 queued, an invalid value returned 422, and the to_flag unit test passed. New suite 7/7 passed; regression iteration34 (Fatek) plus iteration35 (NUL/JSON errors) passed, 28/28 total. UI at 390px with a background publisher every 2 s: chamber 0 AUTO/RĘCZNY buttons are disabled and chamber-0-off-hint shows the correct Polish text. Chambers 1 and 2 buttons are enabled with no hint. Clicking chamber-2-mode-manual sent POST /api/devices/flagui36/command {set_mode, chamber 2, manual}, which returned 200. Simulator kowalski-a end to end: chamber-0-mode-manual switched to manual (RĘCZNY active, sliders and auto-return note shown), then chamber-0-mode-auto switched back to auto. Cleanup done: only kowalski-a and chlodnia-01 remain, and kowalski-a ch0 mode is auto.

minor.issue: Inconsistent: numeric 2 -> True but string "2" -> False (not in TRUE_WORDS). Also strings like "off"/"auto" are correctly false, but any unknown word silently means OFF/auto. Probably acceptable for PLC values; consider treating numeric strings via float(v) != 0.

issues: chamber-N-off-hint is 11px muted text under the mode buttons. It is readable, but it is easy to miss because the chamber header already shows 'WYŁ.'. Optional: slightly larger or warn-colored text.

action_items: Optional: make to_flag treat numeric strings consistently with numbers ("2" -> true)
